plan.gap: No source provides a measured, decision-criteria-based protocol for post-harvest irrigation scheduling or regrowth-specific fertilizer dosage in alfalfa. Existing evidence only includes general cutting-interval ranges, broad P/K-per-ton removal rates, one non-Iranian laboratory irrigation threshold, and a qualitative sugar-reserve rule at ~6 inches height. Measured regrowth-stage irrigation timing triggers and N/P/K fertilization prescriptions are absent.
queries: alfalfa post-harvest irrigation scheduling regrowth university extension
alfalfa regrowth fertilization nitrogen phosphorus potassium recommendations peer-reviewed

requirements.need: Measured post-cutting irrigation decision criteria — soil moisture threshold, scheduling trigger, or volume/frequency specified for alfalfa regrowth phase, from university extension or peer-reviewed field trials.
Alfalfa (Medicago sativa) regrowth-specific nutrient removal and fertilization recommendation with quantified N, P, K rates tied to regrowth stage and yield potential.
Actual field measurements with original units (mm, kg/ha, cm soil moisture, days) and explicit geography/cropping system; conversions only if deterministically verified from the source.
